blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. These results provide a unified framework for defining, evaluating and identifying FRUs in neural networks, and establish a foundation for characterizing the relationship between neural network representations and human conceptual structure.
blocks.zh: 了解神经网络的内部表现并描述其与人的概念结构的关系是阐明模型机制的两个关键问题. 前者揭示了如何将学到的知识组织在内部表述中,而后者为通过人的概念结构来解释这些表述提供了依据。 在此,我们正式界定了基本代表单位,并制定了两项评价标准:忠诚和稳定。 我们进一步证明,阈值活化的稀有自编码器(TSAEs)能够在适当条件下识别具有高度忠诚和稳定性的FRU,并通过大规模实验验证这一结果. 进一步的分析表明,稳定性较高的排污单位表现出更大的单相抗性,可分层组成,以恢复与人类概念结构相适应的语义组织。 这些结果为在神经网络中定义、评价和识别FRU提供了一个统一的框架,并为描述神经网络表现和人类概念结构之间的关系奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: In the following, we first formally define FRUs and introduce fidelity and stability as two evaluation criteria. We then quantitatively compare neurons and learned features as candidate FRUs within this unified framework. Next, we prove that TSAEs can effectively identify representational atoms under appropriate conditions and validate their practical effectiveness through large-scale experiments. We further examine the relationship between stability and monosemanticity, and finally use HowNet to characterize the relationship between neural representations and human conceptual structure.
blocks.zh: 在下文中,我们首先正式界定了财务责任股,并将忠诚和稳定作为两个评价标准。 然后在数量上比较神经元和所学的特征作为这个统一框架内的候选FRU. 其次,我们证明TSAEs能够在适当条件下有效识别代表原子,并通过大规模实验验证其实际效力. 我们进一步审查稳定性和单体抗争之间的关系,最后使用HowNet来描述神经表达和人类概念结构之间的关系.

blocks.en: Representational atoms
blocks.zh: 代表性原子

blocks.en: Neurons and learned features are two widely studied candidates for the basic units of internal representations Chen et al. (2025a) ; Huben et al. (2024) ; Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) , yet neither provides a principled basis for determining what properties representational components must possess to qualify as FRUs. We therefore begin by formalizing this problem and developing a principled definition of FRUs.
blocks.zh: 神经元和学习的特征是内部代表的基本单位的两个被广泛研究的候选人. Chen等人(2025a),Huben等人(2024),Bricken等人(2023),Templeton等人(2024),但两者都没有为确定代表物成分必须拥有何种财产才能成为FRU提供原则依据. 因此,我们首先将这一问题正式化,并拟订一个有关联阵的原则性定义。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Existing representational units exhibit distinct limitations in fidelity and stability. a–c , Fidelity ( R 2 R^{2} , top) and stability ( q ∗ q^{*} , bottom) of neurons and learned features across layers of Gemma2-2B ( a ), Gemma2-9B ( b ) and Llama3.1-8B ( c ). Angular coordinates denote layer indices, and radial coordinates denote the corresponding metric values. The dashed red circle marks the ideal-atom reference, for which both fidelity and stability attain their maximum value of 1. Neurons consistently exhibit high fidelity but substantially lower stability, whereas learned features from Gemma Scope and Llama Scope show improved stability to varying degrees but generally sacrifice fidelity, with neither class simultaneously approaching the ideal reference on both criteria. Across model scales and feature widths, these results reveal a systematic gap between existing candidate FRUs and the criteria for ideal representational atoms.

blocks.en: Having defined fidelity and stability, we next use these criteria to evaluate two widely studied classes of candidate FRUs: neurons and learned features Chen et al. (2025a) ; Huben et al. (2024) ; Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) . Neurons correspond directly to the native coordinates of internal representations, whereas learned features are obtained by decomposing these representations into latent components. For learned features, we use Gemma Scope Lieberum et al. (2024) and Llama Scope He et al. (2024) , both trained on large-scale general-domain corpora (see ‘Evaluation of existing representational units’ in Methods). The results are shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 在确定了忠诚和稳定性之后,我们接下来使用这些标准来评价两个广泛研究的候选FRU类别:神经元和学习的特征 Chen等人(2025a);Huben等人(2024);Bricken等人(2023);Templeton等人(2024)。 神经元直接对应内部代表物的原生坐标,而通过将这些代表物分解成潜在组成部分而获得的学识特征. 对于学到的特征,我们使用Gemma Asception Lieberum等人(2024年)和Llama Asception He等人(2024年),两者都接受了大规模通用公司培训(见 " 评价方法方面的现有代表单位 " )。 结果见图2。

blocks.en: In terms of fidelity, neurons and learned features exhibit a clear contrast. Because internal representations are expressed directly in the original neuronal coordinate system, treating neurons as candidate FRUs preserves the representational information without introducing an additional approximation, making fidelity rarely a primary limitation. Learned features, by contrast, are obtained through learned decompositions of internal representations, and their reconstruction quality depends on model architecture and scale, training data and optimization settings. Pretrained learned-feature models such as Gemma Scope and Llama Scope may therefore not be fully optimized for the target representation distribution, potentially leading to information loss and lower fidelity than neurons, even when yielding more interpretable components Huben et al. (2024) ; Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 在忠诚方面,神经元和学习的特征显示出明显的对比. 由于内部表现直接表现在原神经坐标系统中,将神经元作为候选的FRU来对待,从而保留了表现信息而不引入额外的近似,使得忠诚度很少成为首要限制. 相比之下,学到的特征是通过内部代表的分解而获得的,其重建质量取决于模型结构和规模、培训数据和优化设置。 因此,Gemma Speciality和Llama Special等训练有素的学习型号可能无法充分优化目标代表分布,有可能导致信息丢失和忠诚度低于神经元,即使产生更易解释的成分Huben等人(2024年);Bricken等人(2023年);Templeton等人(2024年)。

blocks.en: In terms of stability, neither neurons nor learned features fully satisfy the distinguishability required of ideal representational atoms. Neurons correspond directly to the coordinate directions of the internal representation space, but these directions need not be sufficiently distinguishable from one another. Consequently, neurons generally exhibit low stability, consistent with the widespread polysemanticity of individual neurons Olah et al. (2020) . Learned features reduce representational entanglement through learned decomposition and exhibit higher stability than neurons, consistent with their greater monosemanticity Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) . However, their stability remains substantially below the ideal regime.
blocks.zh: 在稳定性方面,神经元或所学的特征都不能完全满足理想代表原子所要求的可区分性. Neurons直接对应内部代表空间的坐标方向,但这些方向不需要充分区分. 因此,神经元的稳定性一般较低,与单个神经元Olah等人(2020年)广泛存在的多聚抗性是一致的。 所学的特征通过所学的分解来减少代表的缠绕,并表现出比神经元更高的稳定性,这与它们更大的单体抗体Bricken等人(2023年)一致;Templeton等人(2024年). 然而,它们的稳定仍然远远低于理想的制度。

blocks.en: Overall, neurons and learned features exhibit distinct limitations: neurons preserve high fidelity but exhibit low stability, whereas learned features improve stability but exhibit reduced fidelity and remain below the ideal stability regime. Accordingly, neither fully satisfies the requirements of ideal representational atoms.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,神经元和所学的特征表现出明显的局限性:神经元保持高度的忠诚,但显示的稳定性较低,而所学的特征则提高稳定性,但显示的忠诚度降低,并仍然低于理想的稳定性制度。 因此,两者都不能完全满足理想的代表性原子的要求。

blocks.en: Threshold-activated SAEs identify representational atoms
blocks.zh: 阈值激活 SAEs 识别代表原子

blocks.en: The limitations of existing candidate FRUs raise a central question: what kind of representation learning mechanism can reliably identify representational atoms with both high fidelity and stability?
blocks.zh: 现有候选人FRU的局限性提出了一个中心问题:哪种代表性学习机制能够可靠地确定具有高度忠诚和稳定性的代表性原子?

blocks.en: Our theoretical analysis shows that, under appropriate conditions, threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with both high fidelity and stability (see ‘Identification of atoms’ in Methods; Fig. 1 c). We instantiate TSAEs using BiJumpReLU SAEs, which utilize learnable activation thresholds to identify representational atoms (see ‘SAE architectures’ in Methods). We evaluate their effectiveness across multiple model families, network architectures, and representation modalities, spanning diverse data distributions. We compare BiJumpReLU SAEs with several established SAE architectures Huben et al. (2024) ; Gao et al. (2025) ; Rajamanoharan et al. (2024b) ; Zhu et al. (2026) under the same evaluation framework. Full experimental settings are described in ‘Training details’ in Methods. Table 1 reports the main results for fidelity and stability, the two criteria used to evaluate representational atoms, with additional metrics provided in Extended Data Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们的理论分析表明,在适当条件下,阈值激活的稀有自动编码器(TSAEs)可以识别出既具有高度忠诚性又具有稳定性的FRU(见 " 方法中的原子识别 " ;图1c)。 我们利用BiJumpReLU SAEs对TSAEs进行即时分析,使用可学习的激活阈值来识别代表原子(见方法中的`SAE架构 ' )。 我们评价它们在许多模范家庭、网络架构和代表模式方面的效力,包括不同的数据分布。 我们比较了BiJumpReLU SAEs与若干既定的SAE建筑Huben等人(2024年);Gao等人(2025年);Rajamanoharan等人(2024年b); 朱等人(2026年)在同一个评价框架下. 完整的实验设置在方法的 " 训练细节 " 中描述。 表1报告了忠诚和稳定的主要结果,即用于评价代表原子的两个标准,扩展数据表1提供了额外的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Among the evaluated SAE architectures, BiJumpReLU SAEs consistently maintain high fidelity and stability across all settings, achieving the highest mean value for both metrics in all eight model–dataset combinations. TopK and AbsTopK SAEs retain relatively high fidelity but exhibit substantially lower stability, whereas ReLU SAEs achieve higher stability but generally lower fidelity. JumpReLU SAEs provide the strongest competing results in many settings, but their stability varies markedly across models, from 64.12 to 98.41. In contrast, BiJumpReLU SAEs maintain stability above 98 across all settings while further improving fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在被评价的SAE架构中,BiJumpReLU SAE在各种场合始终保持高度的忠诚和稳定性,在所有8种模型-数据集组合中都实现了两个度量标准的最高平均值。 TopK和AbsTopK SAEs保持相对较高的忠诚度,但表现出的稳定性低得多,而ReLU SAEs则实现了较高的稳定性,但一般的忠诚度较低。 Jump ReLU SAEs在许多场合提供了最强的相互竞争的结果,但其稳定性在模型中差异很大,从64.12到98.41不等. 相比之下,BiJumpReLU SAEs在所有场合都保持98以上的稳定性,同时进一步提高忠诚度。

blocks.en: Together, these theoretical and empirical results show that TSAEs provide an effective approach for identifying representational atoms. BiJumpReLU SAEs serve as a concrete instantiation of this approach and perform consistently across diverse models, architectures, data distributions and representation modalities, providing a practical basis for identifying atoms in neural representations.
blocks.zh: 这些理论和经验的结果表明,TSAE为识别代表原子提供了有效的方法. 双簧管 SAEs是这一方法的具体即时化,在各种模型、结构、数据分布和表达方式之间一致发挥作用,为识别神经表达中的原子提供了实际依据。

blocks.en: Stable atoms are more monosemantic
blocks.zh: 稳定的原子比较单语义

blocks.en: Monosemanticity refers to a representational unit has a consistent semantic meaning, such that its activation reliably corresponds to a specific semantic pattern Huben et al. (2024) ; Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) . Such consistency is necessary for a well-defined interpretation of the unit, as its semantic attribution otherwise remains ambiguous. Monosemanticity therefore provides a basis for analyzing the semantic organization of internal representations.
blocks.zh: 单词指代表单位具有一致的语义含义,因此其激活可靠地对应特定语义图案Huben等人(2024年);Bricken等人(2023年);Templeton等人(2024年). 这种一致性对于明确界定单位的解释是必要的,因为其语义归属在其他方面仍然模糊不清。 因此,单词为分析内部表述的语义组织提供了依据。

blocks.en: Our theoretical analysis shows that stability characterizes the distinguishability required for monorepresentationality, which constitutes a necessary structural condition for monosemanticity (see ‘Evaluation of atoms’ in Methods). However, monorepresentationality is not sufficient, because a structurally well-defined unit may still encode distinctions that do not align with human semantic categories. The relationship between stability and monosemanticity therefore requires empirical validation.
blocks.zh: 我们的理论分析表明,稳定性是单一代表性所需的可区分性的特点,而单一代表性是单一对抗性的必要结构条件(见 " 方法中的原子评估 " )。 然而,单代表性是不够的,因为结构上定义明确的单位可能仍然编码与人类语义类别不一致的区分. 因此,稳定与单一对抗之间的关系需要经验验证。

blocks.en: To test this relationship, we evaluate the monosemanticity of the identified FRUs and examine its association with stability (see ‘Monosemanticity evaluation details’ in Methods). Across all 40 dataset–model–SAE combinations, stability is positively correlated with monosemanticity (Spearman ρ = 0.71 \rho=0.71 , P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 3 a). This association is preserved within each dataset, with correlations of ρ = 0.74 \rho=0.74 for Wikipedia, ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79 for Wikidata and ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 for LAION-COCO (Fig. 3 b–d). Across individual models and representation settings, all eight correlations remain positive, ranging from ρ = 0.37 \rho=0.37 to 0.93 0.93 (Fig. 3 e–l). Architecture-stratified correlations and monosemanticity distributions across SAE architectures are reported in Extended Data Figs. 1 and 2 . Together, these results show that greater stability is consistently associated with greater monosemanticity across model families, representation modalities and SAE architectures.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这种关系,我们评估已查明的联阵的单一性,并审查它与稳定的关系(见方法中的 " 货币评价细节 " )。 在所有40个数据集-模型-SAE组合中,稳定性与单相抗性是正相关联的(Spearman ^ = 0.71\rho= 0.71,P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图3 a)。 这种关联在每一个数据集内都保留下来,维基百科的关联性为: ^ 0.74\rho=0.74,维基百科的关联性为: ^ 0.79\rho=0.79,而LAION-CO的关联性为: ^ 0.95\rho=0.95(图3 b-d). 在各个模型和代表设置中,所有8种关联都保持正相关,从 ^ 0.37\rho=0.37到 0.93 0.93(图3 e-1)。 扩展数据图1和图2中报告了整个SAE架构的架构与结构的相对关系和单一共性分布。 这些结果表明,在模式家庭、代表模式和SAE架构中,稳定程度的提高始终与更大的单一性有关。

blocks.en: Atoms compositionally encode sememe structures
blocks.zh: 原子成分化编码 sememe 结构

blocks.en: Having shown that representational atoms identified by BiJumpReLU SAEs exhibit higher stability and greater monosemanticity, we next examine how these atoms relate to human conceptual structure. Monosemanticity captures the consistency of an FRU’s semantic interpretation, but does not determine whether that FRU alone captures a complete human semantic concept. We therefore investigate whether higher-order semantic structures are encoded by single atoms or by their compositions.
blocks.zh: 在证明BiJumpReLU SAEs确定的代表性原子表现出更高的稳定性和更大的单体抗体之后,我们接下来审查这些原子与人类概念结构的关系。 单调捕捉FRU语义解释的一致性,但不能确定FRU单调是否捕捉到一个完整的人类语义概念. 因此,我们调查更高顺序的语义结构是由单原子编码还是由它们的成分编码.

blocks.en: We use HowNet Qi et al. (2019) ; Dong and Dong (2003) , an expert-annotated knowledge base in which concepts are described by fine-grained semantic units called sememes. We extract internal representations of HowNet entities across layers from multiple models and identify corresponding representational atoms using BiJumpReLU SAEs (see ‘Representation extraction for cross-layer semantic alignment’ in Methods). These SAEs maintain high fidelity and stability across the evaluated models and layers (Extended Data Table 4 ). For each sememe, we identify the single atom with the highest set-matching F1 score across layers, where F1 summarizes the precision and recall of the atom–sememe match, and then search for the cross-layer atom combination that maximizes the same score (see ‘Semantic alignment evaluation details’ in Methods).
blocks.zh: 我们使用HowNet Qi等人(2019年);董和东(2003年),这是一个专家附加说明的知识库,其中概念由精细的语义单元描述,称为sememes. 我们从多个模型中提取不同层的HowNet实体的内部表示,并使用BiJumpReLU SAEs(见方法中的 " 跨层语义对齐的代表提取 " )确定相应的代表原子。 这些高级经济实体在整个评估模型和层次上保持高度的忠诚和稳定性(扩展数据表4)。 对于每个sememe,我们确定单个原子的设定比对F1分数最高的跨层,其中F1总结了原子的精确度和召回度-sememe比对,然后搜索能够最大化同一分数的跨层原子组合(见方法中的"语义比对评价细节").

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , near one-to-one correspondences between sememes and atoms are rare. Although some sememes can be recovered almost completely by a single atom, with F1 reaching 1 (Fig. 4 a), such cases account for only approximately 1% of all sememes (Fig. 4 b). Most sememes require multiple atoms, with the majority involving more than six atoms across all three models (Fig. 4 b). These atom combinations achieve substantially higher semantic alignment (F1) than the corresponding best single atoms (Fig. 4 c), primarily through higher recall without sacrificing precision (Extended Data Table 3 ). The number of selected atoms also increases systematically with sememe complexity, measured by the number of associated entities (Fig. 4 d). These results suggest that representational atoms generally function as finer-grained semantic components whose compositions encode higher-order human semantic structures.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,近一对一的介于sememes和原子之间的通信很少见. 虽然一些sememes几乎可以通过单个原子完全恢复,F1达到了1(图4 a),但这类病例只占所有sememes(图4 b)的约1%. 大多数sememes需要多个原子,大多数涉及所有三种模型的超过6个原子(图4b). 这些原子组合实现的语义对齐(F1)大大高于相应的最佳单原子(图4 c),主要通过更高的召回而不牺牲精度(Expendent Data table 3 . 选定的原子数量也随着sememe复杂性而系统增加,以关联实体的数量来衡量(图4d)。 这些结果表明,代表原子一般作为细纹的语义成分发挥作用,其成分编码为更高顺序的人类语义结构.

Each blue point denotes the merged F1 obtained for an individual sememe at corresponding cross-layer width. blocks.en: To determine whether this compositional advantage could arise from the cross-layer search procedure, we examine the association between cross-layer width and final F1. The Pearson correlation between them is close to zero, and the equivalence test Lakens (2017) confirms that it falls within the prespecified bound of | r | < 0.10 |r|<0.10 ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 5 ), indicating no practically meaningful association. Final F1 therefore does not increase systematically with cross-layer width, supporting the interpretation that the advantage of atom combinations reflects compositional structure in the internal representations rather than the search procedure.
blocks.zh: 为了确定这种组成优势能否来自跨层搜索程序,我们研究跨层宽度与最终F1之间的联系. 他们之间的皮尔逊关联接近于零,等效测试Lakens(2017年)证实,它属于预先划定的QQ r < 0.10 r|<0.10(P < 0.001 P < 0.001;图5),表明没有实际有意义的关联. 因此,最终F1并没有以跨层宽度系统增加,支持原子组合的优势在内部表达而不是搜索程序中反映组成结构的解释.

blocks.en: Case-study analysis further reveals discrepancies between the entity sets recovered by atom combinations and the corresponding HowNet annotations (Extended Data Table 5 ; see ‘Sememe evaluation details’ in Methods). Manual inspection identifies unannotated entities that are consistent with the target sememes, as well as annotated entities that appear inconsistent with them. These cases suggest that some apparent mismatches may reflect incomplete or inaccurate annotations. Together, these findings show that single atoms capture finer-grained semantic components, while their compositions recover higher-order semantic organization that closely corresponds to human conceptual structure.
blocks.zh: 案例研究分析进一步揭示了实体通过原子组合回收的数据集与相应的HowNet说明之间的差异(扩展数据表5;见方法中的 " 系统评价细节 " )。 人工检查查明了与目标组合一致的无说明实体,以及似乎与目标组合不一致的无说明实体。 这些案件表明,一些明显的不匹配可能反映出说明不完整或不准确。 这些发现共同表明,单原子捕捉到细纹的语义成分,而它们的成分则恢复了与人类概念结构紧密对应的更高序的语义组织.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study focuses on a fundamental question concerning the basic units that constitute internal representations of neural networks and how their organization relates to human conceptual structure. We formulate this problem in terms of the definition, evaluation, and identification of fundamental representational units (FRUs). Drawing on compressed sensing Donoho (2006) ; Candès et al. (2006) , we define FRUs as representational atoms and introduce fidelity and stability to characterize information preservation and structural distinguishability. We further show that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify such atoms under appropriate conditions, instantiate TSAEs as BiJumpReLU SAEs in practice, and validate their effectiveness across diverse models and representation settings. Further analysis indicates that more stable atoms also exhibit greater empirical monosemanticity, and their cross-layer compositions recover higher-order semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. Together, these findings provide a unified theoretical and practical framework for characterizing the basic organization of neural representations and its relationship to human conceptual structure.
blocks.zh: 这项研究侧重于一个基本问题,即构成神经网络内部代表的基本单位及其组织与人类概念结构的关系。 我们在界定、评价和确定基本代表单位方面提出了这一问题。 利用压缩感知多诺霍(2006年);Candès等人(2006年),我们把FRU定义为代表原子,并引入忠诚和稳定性,以描述信息的保存和结构可辨别性。 我们进一步表明,阈值激活的稀有自动编码器(TSAEs)可以在适当条件下识别此类原子,在实践中将TSAEs作为BiJumpReLU SAEs即时化,并验证其在不同模型和代表设置中的有效性。 进一步的分析表明,比较稳定的原子也表现出更大的经验单体抗体,它们的跨层组成恢复了与人类概念结构相对应的更高序语义组织. 这些发现共同为描述神经表达的基本组织及其与人类概念结构的关系提供了统一的理论和实践框架.

blocks.en: This framework provides a principled view of commonly studied representational units. Neurons and learned features can be evaluated within the same theoretical setting through fidelity and stability, rather than being treated solely as empirical units of interpretation. More broadly, the framework connects two influential perspectives on neural representation: the linear representation hypothesis Park et al. (2023) , in which semantic information is encoded along specific directions, and the superposition hypothesis Elhage et al. (2022) , which explains how finite-dimensional spaces can support substantially more linear components than their dimensionality. Their combination within a sparse linear framework provides a unified account of how representational components can remain both expressive and distinguishable.
blocks.zh: 这一框架提供了共同研究的代表单位的原则观点。 神经元和所学的特征可以通过忠诚和稳定性在相同的理论环境下进行评估,而不是仅仅作为经验性解释单位来对待. 更广泛地说,框架将神经表达的两个有影响的视角联系起来:线性表达假说Park et al. (2023),其中语义信息按照具体方向编码,叠位假说. Elhage et al. (2022),它解释了有限维空间能够支持的线性成分大大超过它们的维度. 它们在一个稀少的线性框架内的结合提供了一种统一的描述,说明代表部分如何能够保持表达性和可区分性。

blocks.en: The compositional organization of representational atoms also has implications for interventions on internal representations, including knowledge editing Meng et al. (2022) ; Meng et al. (2023) ; Hu et al. (2024) and representation steering Rimsky et al. (2024) ; Rodriguez et al. (2025) . Such methods often rely on mapping human-defined target concepts to localizable representational structures. Our results suggest that these correspondences are often mediated by finer-grained representational atoms and their combinations, which jointly form higher-order semantic structures. Intervening on a single direction or localized representation may therefore affect only part of a target concept or simultaneously perturb multiple overlapping semantic components. This perspective may help explain incomplete edits, collateral effects and instability, and suggests that future intervention methods should explicitly consider the compositional and superpositional organization of FRUs.
blocks.zh: 代表原子的构成组织也对内部代表干预产生影响,包括知识编辑Meng等人(2022年);Meng等人(2023年);Hu等人(2024年)和代表指导Rimsky等人(2024年);Rodriguez等人(2025年)。 这类方法往往依靠将人类定义的目标概念绘制成可本地化的代表结构。 我们的结果显示,这些函证往往通过细纹代表原子及其组合进行调解,它们共同形成更高阶的语义结构. 因此,干涉单一方向或局部代表可能只影响目标概念的一部分,或同时扰动多个重叠语义部分. 这种观点可能有助于解释不完全的编辑、附带影响和不稳定性,并建议今后的干预方法应明确考虑燃料排放单位的组成和叠加组织。

blocks.en: This representational perspective is also relevant to continual learning Kirkpatrick et al. (2017) ; Van de Ven et al. (2022) . Continual learning modifies internal representations through parameter updates, and superposition implies that changes to representations may perturb multiple overlapping components and thereby affect existing knowledge. This provides a possible structural account of catastrophic forgetting and suggests that robust continual learning may therefore benefit from explicitly considering the superpositional organization of FRUs. More broadly, this framework provides a basis for studying how models integrate new information while preserving previously encoded knowledge.
blocks.zh: 这种代表性观点也与持续学习Kirkpatrick等人(2017年);Van de Ven等人(2022年)有关。 持续学习通过参数更新来修改内部表达,叠加意味着表达方式的改变可能会扰动多个重叠的组件,从而影响现有的知识. 这为灾难性的遗忘提供了一种可能的结构性说法,并表明,明确考虑排减单位的叠加性组织可能有利于强有力的持续学习。 更广泛地说,这个框架为研究模型如何在保存先前编码的知识的同时整合新信息提供了基础.

blocks.en: A natural question is whether this framework generalizes across diverse neural networks and internal representations. Its generality ultimately depends on whether stable and semantically meaningful representational atoms emerge across different models and representation spaces. Importantly, fidelity and stability provide quantitative criteria for assessing this applicability without assuming it a priori. Across the models and representation settings examined here, we observe consistent evidence for representational atoms, supporting their use as a testable and extensible basis for studying neural representations and their semantic organization.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题就是这个框架是否概括了各种神经网络和内部表现. 其普遍性最终取决于在不同的模型和代表空间中是否出现稳定且具有象征意义的代表性原子. 重要的是,忠诚和稳定性为评估这种适用性提供了数量标准,而无须预先假定。 在本文审查的模型和表述环境中,我们观察到代表原子的一致证据,支持将其用作研究神经表达及其语义结构的可检验和可扩展的基础。

(2025) can also be viewed as special cases of threshold-based activation, but their one-sided activation implicitly fixes a positive orientation for each representational direction. blocks.en: To assess the applicability of the theoretical framework across model architectures and representation types, we conduct experiments on neural networks spanning multiple parameter scales, architectures and generative modalities. Data preprocessing and hyperparameter selection

blocks.en: Internal representations can differ substantially in numerical scale across models, layers, and extraction sites, making SAE training highly sensitive to hyperparameter choices and complicating the use of a unified training configuration. We first observed on Gemma-2-2B that SAEs trained directly on raw activations were stable in shallow layers but became increasingly unstable in deeper layers, largely due to pronounced variation in activation scale across depth. Scaling each internal representation by the global standard deviation restored stable training across layers, with consistent behavior in Gemma-2-9B. For representations extracted from sites such as ‘down_proj‘, which are not normalized by ‘post_feedforward_layernorm‘, standard-deviation scaling alone did not yield sufficiently consistent numerical distributions. We therefore applied RMS normalization without learnable affine parameters, scaling each internal representation by its root mean square. This produced stable training for Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Olmo-Hybrid-7B, Stable Diffusion v1.5 and FLUX.2-klein-9B. Accordingly, representations extracted from ‘post_feedforward_layernorm‘ in Gemma-2-2B and Gemma-2-9B use standard-deviation scaling, whereas representations from ‘down_proj‘ and other unnormalized sites use RMS normalization. Both operations apply only a scalar rescaling to each representation vector, preserving its direction and therefore the representational geometry considered here, and the original numerical scale can be recovered directly using the corresponding scaling factor.

blocks.en: Training dynamics and early stopping
blocks.zh: 培训动态和及早停止

blocks.en: SAE training is commonly viewed as a trade-off between reconstruction quality and sparsity Gao et al. (2025) , but we observe a consistent training dynamic across multiple experimental settings. For BiJumpReLU SAEs, reconstruction and sparsity losses typically decrease together during early and intermediate training. As training progresses, the reconstruction loss gradually plateaus and may subsequently increase slightly but persistently, while sparsity continues to improve. Both objectives eventually reach an approximately stable regime. This pattern indicates that late-stage optimization primarily trades a limited change in reconstruction quality for increased sparsity, rather than continuing to improve both objectives simultaneously. Based on this dynamic, we adopt a trajectory-based early stopping criterion. For BiJumpReLU and JumpReLU SAEs, we smooth the training-loss curves and stop training near the transition at which reconstruction loss shifts from sustained decrease to a stable increase while sparsity continues to improve. This stage typically already corresponds to high fidelity and stability, allowing us to avoid unnecessary late-stage trade-offs while preserving atom-identification quality. For ReLU SAEs, where this transition is generally less pronounced, training is stopped when neither reconstruction nor sparsity loss shows further substantial improvement. For Top K K and AbsTop K K SAEs, whose sparsity is explicitly fixed by K K , training is stopped when the reconstruction performance no longer improves appreciably.
blocks.zh: SAE培训通常被认为是重建质量与Sparsity Gao等人(2025年)之间的一种权衡,但我们观察到,在多个实验环境中,培训是始终如一的。 双弹簧管 在早期和中期培训期间,特别经济企业、重建和垃圾邮件损失通常同时减少。 随着培训的进行,重建损失逐渐高涨,随后可能略有增加但持续增加,而垃圾情况则继续改善。 这两个目标最终都达到了一个大致稳定的制度。 这种模式表明,晚期优化主要是为了增加垃圾堆而改变重建质量,而不是同时继续改善这两个目标。 基于这一动态,我们采用基于轨迹的早期停止标准。 对于BiJumpReLU和JumpRELU SAEs,我们平滑了训练-损失曲线,并在重建损失从持续减少转向稳定增加的过渡附近停止训练,而Sparsity则继续改善。 这一阶段通常已经与高度忠诚和稳定相对应,使我们能够避免不必要的后期权衡,同时保持原子识别的质量。 对RELU SAEs来说,这种过渡一般不太明显,但当重建或痉挛损失都没有显示出进一步的实质性改善时,就停止培训。 对于Top K K和AbsTop K K SAEs来说,它们的痉挛性由K K 明确固定,当重建性能不再明显改善时,就停止培训.

blocks.en: Evaluation of existing representational units
blocks.zh: 现有代表单位的评价

blocks.en: To evaluate existing representational units within a unified framework, we treat neurons and learned features by publicly available SAEs as candidate FRUs and assess them using the fidelity and stability metrics defined above. All evaluations use approximately 20 ​ K 20\text{K} entities appearing in CounterFact Meng et al. (2022) , which can be regarded as a subset of Wikidata entities. Each entity is converted into a corresponding prompt and fed into the model, and internal representations are extracted at the final token position of the target site. Neurons and learned features are evaluated directly using the original models and publicly released SAE checkpoints, without additional training or parameter tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了在统一的框架内评价现有代表单位,我们把公开的SAE作为候选的FRU来对待神经元和所学到的特征,并使用上文定义的忠诚度和稳定性度量来评估它们。 所有评价都使用大约20K 20\text{K}出现在Found Fact Meng等人(2022年)中的实体,这些实体可被视为Wikidata实体的子集. 每个实体被转换成相应的即时并输入模型,在目标地点的最后象征性位置提取内部表示。 Neurons和学习到的特征直接使用原始模型和公开发布的SAE检查站进行评价,没有额外的训练或参数调试.

blocks.en: For neurons, we extract the input to the MLP ‘down_proj‘ at each layer. This vector corresponds to the activations of the intermediate MLP neurons, with each component indicating the activation strength of the corresponding neuron. The columns of the ‘down_proj‘ weight matrix are therefore treated as the representational directions associated with individual neurons, and the corresponding input activations as their coefficients, allowing the MLP residual update to be expressed as a linear combination of neuron directions. Fidelity and stability are then computed for neurons as candidate FRUs according to the definitions above.
blocks.zh: 对于神经元,我们提取每个层的 MLP `down_proj'的输入. 这种矢量对应中间MLP神经元的激活,每个元件都表示相应的神经元的激活强度. 因此,`下-proj ' 权重矩阵的列作为与单个神经元相关的表达方向,相应的输入激活作为它们的系数,使得MLP残基更新能够以神经元方向的线性组合表示. 然后根据上述定义计算神经元作为候选的FRU的清晰度和稳定性。

blocks.en: For learned features, we use the pretrained SAEs provided by Gemma Scope Lieberum et al. (2024) and Llama Scope He et al. (2024) , following their official settings. For Gemma-2-2B and Gemma-2-9B, we extract representations at the output of ‘post_feedforward_layernorm‘ from each layer and apply the corresponding Gemma Scope SAE. For Llama-3.1-8B, we extract representations at the output of ‘down_proj‘ from each layer and apply the corresponding Llama Scope SAE. The decoder directions of each SAE are treated as candidate FRUs, and the latent activations as their coefficients. The resulting SAE reconstructions are used to compute fidelity, whereas feature coherence and activation sparsity are used to compute stability under the same evaluation procedure.
blocks.zh: 对于学到的特性,我们使用Gemma Asception Lieberum等人(2024年)和Llama Asception He等人(2024年)按照官方设置提供的经过预先训练的SAE。 对于Gemma-2-2B和Gemma-2-9B,我们从每个层的输出“post_feedforward_layernorm”中提取表示,并应用相应的Gemma范围SAE. 对于Llama-3.1-8B,我们从每一层的“下-proj”输出中提取表示值,并应用相应的Llama范围SAE。 每个SAE的解码器方向作为候选的FRU处理,潜在激活作为它们的系数. 由此产生的SAE重建用于计算忠诚度,而特征一致性和激活性则用于计算同一评价程序下的稳定性。

blocks.en: Monosemanticity evaluation details
blocks.zh: 单调性评价细节

blocks.en: To evaluate the monosemanticity of the candidate FRUs, we use a common scoring criterion across language models and diffusion models, with modality-specific evaluation procedures. For language models, including Gemma-2-2B, Gemma-2-9B, Qwen3.5-9B and Olmo-Hybrid-7B, we use an LLM-as-a-judge protocol supplemented by manual verification. For diffusion models, including Stable Diffusion v1.5 and FLUX.2-klein-9B, we use manual evaluation. Both procedures follow the same definition of monosemanticity and a closely matched scoring template.
blocks.zh: 为了评价候选的FRU的单一性,我们使用一种通用的分数标准,跨越语言模型和传播模型,并采用特定模式的评价程序。 对于语言模型,包括Gemma-2-2B,Gemma-2-9B,Quen3.5-9B和Olmo-Hybrid-7B,我们使用LLM-as-a-judge协议,辅以人工验证. 对于传播模型,包括稳定扩散v1.5和FLUX.2-klein-9B,我们使用人工评估. 两种程序都遵循单一抗体的相同定义和一个紧密匹配的评分模板.

blocks.en: For each model and representation extraction site, we randomly sample 10 candidate FRUs identified by the corresponding SAE and collect the input instances that activate each unit. If more than 10 instances are activated, we randomly sample 10 for evaluation. The evaluated instances are contextualized tokens for Wikipedia, entities for Wikidata and local image patches for LAION-COCO. For each candidate FRU, we identify the largest subset S max S_{\max} of evaluated instances that can be coherently explained by a common concept, attribute or semantic pattern, and define its monosemanticity score as Monosemanticity = | S max | | S | , \mathrm{Monosemanticity}=\frac{|S_{\max}|}{|S|}, (24) where S S denotes the complete set of evaluated instances for that unit. Scores closer to 1 indicate that the unit activates more consistently on a coherent semantic pattern. Finally, we average the monosemanticity scores of the sampled units within each SAE setting to obtain its overall monosemanticity score.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型和代表提取点,我们随机抽取对应SAE确定的10个候选FRU,并收集激活每个单元的输入实例. 如果启动10例以上,我们随机抽样进行10例评估。 被评价的实例是维基百科的上下文符号,维基数据的实体和LAION-COCO的本地图像补丁. 对于每个候选的 FRU, 我们找出了最大的子集 S max S max } 用一个共同的概念,属性或语义模式可以一致解释的被评价的例, 并将其单调的分数定义为 Monosemanticity = = | S max | S | S | S ,\ mathrm{ Monosemanticity }=\ Frac{| S_{\max}|}{| S |}(24), 其中 S 表示该单位完整的被评价的一组例. 接近1的分数表明,该单位以一致的语义模式更一致地激活. 最后,我们平均每个SAE设置中抽样单位的单倍比分,以获得其整体单倍比分.

blocks.en: Semantic alignment evaluation details
blocks.zh: 语义一致性评价细节

blocks.en: HowNet Qi et al. (2019) contains 2,540 sememes, each associated with a set of entities belonging to the corresponding semantic category. To ensure that subsequent set-based comparisons are meaningful, we retain only sememes containing at least two unique entities, yielding 2,135 sememes, which we use as an operational representation of human conceptual semantic structure. On the model side, we extract internal representations corresponding to HowNet entities at every layer and train BiJumpReLU SAEs at each layer to identify atoms. For each unit, we record the set of entities that activate it and likewise retain only units associated with at least two unique entities. Each retained sememe and representational unit can therefore be represented as an entity set, providing a common basis for comparing neural representational structure with human conceptual structure.
blocks.zh: HowNet Qi 等 (英语). (2019年)包含2,540 sememes,每个都与一组属于相应语义类的实体相关. 为了确保随后的设定比较有意义,我们只保留至少包含两个独特实体的sememes,产生2,135个sememes,我们用它作为人类概念语义结构的操作代表. 在模型方面,我们提取每层HowNet实体对应的内部表示,并在每层培训BiJumpReLU SAEs以识别原子. 对于每个单位,我们记录起动它的一组实体,同样只保留与至少两个独特实体有关的单位. 因此,每个保留体和代表单位都可以作为实体集合来代表,为将神经代表结构与人的概念结构进行比较提供了一个共同的基础。

blocks.en: To evaluate semantic alignment between single atoms and HowNet sememes, we compute precision, recall and F1 based on the overlap between their corresponding entity sets. For each sememe, we search across all atoms identified at all layers and define the unit with the highest F1 score as its best single-unit match. This metric jointly reflects the semantic purity of a atom and its coverage of the target sememe, thereby quantifying the extent to which an single atoms corresponds to human conceptual semantic structure. Detailed set construction, metric definitions and cross-layer search procedures are provided in ‘Single-atom semantic alignment evaluation’ in the Supplementary Information.
blocks.zh: 为了评价单个原子和HowNet sememes之间的语义吻合,我们根据它们相应的实体集之间的重叠来计算精度,召回和F1. 对于每个sememe,我们搜索所有层次上确定的所有原子,并将F1得分最高的单位定义为其最好的单单位匹配. 这个度量法共同反映了一个原子的语义纯度及其覆盖目标sememe,从而量化了单个原子与人类概念语义结构对应的程度. 补充信息中的 " 单一原子语义校正评价 " 提供了详细的成套构建、计量定义和跨层搜索程序。

blocks.en: Building on the single-atom analysis, we further assess whether combinations of atoms can recover sememe structure more completely. We aggregate candidate FRUs identified across all layers, prefilter them according to their correspondence with the target sememe entity set, and then perform greedy compositional search by iteratively adding the atom that yields the largest improvement in the current F1 score. Search terminates when no further positive gain is obtained or when a prespecified maximum combination size is reached. The candidate-filtering threshold and maximum combination size are selected by grid search (Supplementary Fig. 1). This analysis compares the coverage achieved by single atoms and atom combinations for the same sememe and tests whether higher-level human conceptual semantic structures can be formed compositionally from representational atoms distributed across layers. Detailed procedures for candidate construction, compositional search and hyperparameter selection are provided in ‘Semantic alignment evaluation’ in the Supplementary Information.
blocks.zh: 在单原子分析的基础上,我们进一步评估原子的组合是否能够更彻底地恢复精密结构. 我们汇总所有层次上确认的候选人FRU,根据他们与目标sememe实体集的通信进行预过滤,然后通过迭代加原子进行贪婪的成分搜索,这些原子在当前F1分数中产生最大的改进. 当没有获得进一步的正增益或达到预先指定的最大组合大小时,搜索终止. 候选过滤阈值和最大组合大小通过网格搜索选择(补充图1)。 本分析比较了单个原子和原子组合为同一sememe所实现的覆盖范围,并测试了更高层次的人类概念语义结构能否从分布于不同层层的代表性原子中组成. 补充资料中的 " 语义调整评价 " 规定了候选人构建、组成搜索和超参数选择的详细程序。

blocks.en: To further assess whether the AIP provides a more appropriate characterization of neural representational geometry than the Euclidean inner product, we compare the distributions of pairwise angles under the two metrics. Specifically, we randomly sample 128 entities from Wikidata Vrandečić and Krötzsch (2014) and extract their internal representations across multiple layers of several language models. For each entity, the activation at its final token position is used as the corresponding representation Meng et al. (2022) , and pairwise angles between entity representations are computed independently at each layer.

Across models and layers, the resulting angular distributions consistently deviate from 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} (Supplementary Fig. 1 - 3 ). We refer to this phenomenon as representation shift. blocks.en: These observations are particularly relevant to the distinguishability criterion used in our framework. Stability depends on the coherence between candidate representational units, which is determined by their relative geometry. Under the Euclidean metric affected by a shared directional bias, units without strong structural correspondence may nevertheless exhibit elevated similarity, thereby obscuring the coherence arising from the underlying representational structure. By contrast, the AIP corrects this global bias and captures the underlying geometry relevant to representational distinguishability. These results therefore provide empirical support for using the AIP, rather than the standard Euclidean inner product, in our theoretical analysis and stability evaluation.

blocks.en: Monosemanticity evaluation
blocks.zh: 单调性评价

blocks.en: This section provides further details on the implementation of the monosemanticity evaluation described in Methods, including the criteria used to determine semantic coherence, the LLM-as-a-judge prompts and manual verification procedure for language models, and the manual evaluation criteria for diffusion models. All evaluations follow the unified monosemanticity criterion defined in the main text: for the activation instances of a representational unit, we identify the largest subset S max S_{\max} that can be consistently explained by a common semantic interpretation, and compute its monosemanticity score as | S max | / | S | |S_{\max}|/|S| .
blocks.zh: 本节进一步详细介绍方法中描述的单一抗体评价的执行情况,包括用于确定语义一致性的标准、语言模型的LLM-as-a-judge提示和人工核查程序,以及传播模型的人工评价标准。 所有评价都遵循主要文本中定义的统一单质抗争标准: 对于一个代表单位的激活实例,我们确定一个能够用共同语义解释一致解释的最大子集S max S_{\max},并计算其单质抗争得分为QQS max | S|max}|/| S|.

blocks.en: Criteria for semantic coherence
blocks.zh: 语义一致性标准

blocks.en: For a given representational unit, we identify the largest subset of instances that can be explained by a shared concept, attribute or semantic pattern with a clear and specific meaning. The shared interpretation must be sufficiently semantically specific and cannot rely solely on an overly broad superordinate category. For example, the fact that multiple instances are all “entities”, “words” or “visual patterns” is not, by itself, sufficient to constitute a valid shared interpretation. Likewise, weak topical relatedness, indirect association or incidental co-occurrence is insufficient to group instances into the same subset.
blocks.zh: 对于一个特定的代表单位,我们找出了能够由具有明确和具体含义的共同概念,属性或语义模式来解释的最大子集. 共同解释必须足够具体,不能仅仅依赖过于宽泛的上层类别。 例如,多种情况都是“实体”、“词语”或“视觉模式”本身不足以构成有效的共同解释。 同样,与专题有关的薄弱性、间接联系或偶然的共犯不足以将实例归入同一子集。

blocks.en: Instances may differ substantially in their surface form, provided that they share the same underlying semantic concept, attribute or function in the relevant context. For a candidate interpretation, only instances that are directly and consistently accounted for by that interpretation are included in S max S_{\max} ; an instance is not included merely because it bears a weak relation to the other instances. If multiple plausible semantic interpretations exist, we select the interpretation that consistently accounts for the largest number of instances, and define the corresponding set of instances as S max S_{\max} .
blocks.zh: 实例在表面形式上可能有很大差异,但前提是它们具有相同的相关语义概念、属性或功能。 就候选人解释而言,只有这种解释直接和一贯说明的情况才列入S Max S_{\max};没有列入这种情况,只是因为它与其他情况的关系薄弱。 如果存在多种似是而非的语义解释,我们则选择一致表示最多实例的解释,并将相应的一组实例定义为 S max S_{\max} 。 。 。

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation for language models
blocks.zh: 语文模式的LLM-as-a-judge评价

blocks.en: For language models, we evaluate Wikipedia and Wikidata representations separately. For Wikipedia, each evaluation instance corresponds to a target token that activates the representational unit. To avoid basing the evaluation solely on the lexical form of the target token, we provide the evaluation model with the local context surrounding the token and explicitly highlight the target token. The evaluation model then determines whether different instances share a coherent semantic pattern based on the meaning or semantic function of the target token in its specific context. For Wikidata, each instance corresponds to the name of an entity that activates the representational unit, and the evaluation model identifies the largest coherent subset based on the entities’ identities, types, attributes or semantic roles.
blocks.zh: 对于语言模型,我们分别评价维基百科和维基数据表示. 对于维基百科来说,每个评价实例都对应一个激活代表单位的目标符号. 为了避免评价完全以目标标志的词汇形式为基础,我们提供评价模式,说明该标志的当地背景,并明确突出目标标志。 然后,评价模式根据目标符号在具体上下文的含义或语义功能,确定不同实例是否具有一致的语义模式。 对于Wikidata来说,每个实例都对应一个激活代表单位的实体的名称,评价模型根据实体的身份,类型,属性或语义角色,确定最大的连贯子集.

blocks.en: For each representational unit, the evaluation model is provided with all instances included in the evaluation and is asked to determine the largest subset that can be consistently explained by a common semantic concept, attribute or pattern.
blocks.zh: 对每个代表单位而言,评价模式都包含评价中的所有实例,并要求它确定能够以共同语义概念、属性或模式一致解释的最大子集。

blocks.en: For Wikipedia representations, we use the following prompt:
blocks.zh: 对于维基百科的表示,我们使用以下的提示:

blocks.en: Below are {num_examples} activation examples from the same SAE feature. Focus on the highlighted token […] in each context. Determine the largest number of examples that can reasonably be grouped into ONE coherent semantic category. Use a reasonably specific category based on the highlighted token’s meaning or semantic function. {examples_text} Reply ONLY as M/ {num_examples} , where M is the size of the largest coherent semantic group. Do not explain.

Determine the largest number of examples that can reasonably be grouped into ONE coherent semantic category. blocks.en: Manual verification of LLM-judge outputs
blocks.zh: 人工核查LLM法官产出

blocks.en: The LLM judge returns the size of the largest semantically coherent group of instances as M / | S | M/|S| , where M M corresponds to | S max | |S_{\max}| . This output format directly provides the subset cardinality required to compute the monosemanticity score, while minimizing the influence of additional generated content on the evaluation.
blocks.zh: LLM评委将最大集合性案例组的大小回归为M / | S | M / | S | | M | S| | , M M 对应 | S 最大 | S_{\ Max}| }| }| S_{\ }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| }| S_{\ }| }| }| 这种输出格式直接提供了计算单调分数所需的子集中心性,同时最大限度地减少额外生成的内容对评价的影响.

blocks.en: To mitigate potential inconsistencies in automated judgements of semantic boundaries, overly broad categories or weak semantic associations, we further manually verify the scores produced by the LLM judge. Manual verification follows the same criteria as the automated evaluation. Specifically, the evaluator examines the same set of activation instances and determines the largest number of instances that can be consistently explained by a shared concept, attribute or semantic pattern with reasonable semantic specificity. Groups based only on overly broad categories, indirect semantic associations or weak topical relatedness are not considered semantically coherent.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻语义边界、过于宽泛的类别或弱的语义联系等自动判断中可能出现的不一致之处,我们进一步手动核实LLM法官的分数。 人工核查遵循与自动评价相同的标准。 具体地说,评价者审查同一套激活实例,并确定能够由具有合理语义特性的共同概念、属性或语义模式一致解释的最大实例。 仅仅基于过分宽泛的类别、间接语义联系或薄弱的话题关联的团体,在整体上不被认为是连贯的。

blocks.en: When the value of M M returned by the LLM judge is consistent with these criteria, the original score is retained. When the automated judgement and manual assessment disagree, M M is revised according to the size of the largest semantically coherent group identified during manual verification. The verified value of M M is then used as | S max | |S_{\max}| to compute the final monosemanticity score for the representational unit.
blocks.zh: 当LLM裁判返回的MM值符合这些标准时,保留原得分. 当自动判断和人工评估有分歧时,M M根据人工核查中确定的最大整体一致性小组的规模进行修改. MM的校验值随后作为QQ S max QQS max 用于计算代表单位的最终单调分数.

blocks.en: Manual evaluation for diffusion models
blocks.zh: 传播模式的手工评价

blocks.en: For Stable Diffusion v1.5 and FLUX.2-klein-9B, we apply the same largest-coherent-subset criterion as for language models. Because the evaluation instances correspond to local visual regions in LAION-COCO images, we perform the evaluation manually. For each representational unit, the evaluator jointly examines all local image instances included in the evaluation and identifies the largest subset that can be explained by a shared visual semantic concept, attribute or pattern. Valid shared interpretations may correspond to object categories, object parts, semantically meaningful visual attributes, or other local structures that retain a consistent semantic meaning across different images. Representative examples of this evaluation procedure for Stable Diffusion v1.5 and FLUX.2-klein-9B are shown in Supplementary Figs. 8 and 9 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 对于稳定扩散v1.5和FLUX.2-klein-9B,我们采用与语言模型相同的最大协同子集标准. 由于评价实例与LAION-COCO图像中的当地视觉区域相对应,我们手动进行评价。 对于每个代表单位,评价人员共同审查评价中包括的所有当地图像实例,并找出一个最大的子集,可以用共同的视觉语义概念、属性或模式来解释。 有效的共享解释可能对应对象类别,对象部分,有集合意义的视觉属性,或者其他在不同的图像中保留一致语义含义的局部结构. 稳定扩散v1.5和FLUX.2-klein-9B这一评价程序的代表性例子见补充图表。 分别见第8和第9段。

blocks.en: Instances that exhibit only low-level visual similarity without a shared semantic interpretation are not considered monosemantic matches. For example, if multiple local regions share similar colours, simple textures or other low-level statistical properties but cannot be assigned a consistent semantic interpretation, they are not grouped into the same subset on this basis alone. Conversely, a visual attribute can be treated as a shared pattern if it has a stable and interpretable semantic meaning across instances. Once S max S_{\max} is identified, the monosemanticity score is computed using the same definition as for language models.
blocks.zh: 仅表现出低水平视觉相似性而没有共同语义解释的事例,不视为单语义匹配. 例如,如果多个局部区域有相似的颜色,简单的纹理或其他低层次的统计属性,但不能被指定一个一致的语义解释,那么它们不会单独根据这个基础被归为同一个子集. 反之,视觉属性如果在各种情况中具有稳定和可解释的语义意义,则可以视为共同的图案. 一旦S Max S_{\max} 被识别出来, 单倍比分的计算使用与语言模型相同的定义 。

blocks.en: Sampling and aggregation details

blocks.en: Monosemanticity evaluation is performed independently for each model, data source and representation extraction site. For each setting, we randomly sample 10 candidate representational units learned by the corresponding SAE for evaluation. For each unit, we use at most 10 activation instances. If more than 10 activated instances are available, we randomly sample 10 from the full set of activated instances; if fewer than 10 are available, we use all available instances. Consequently, | S | |S| may be smaller than 10 for some units. We then compute the monosemanticity score for each representational unit separately and average the scores of the sampled units within the same SAE setting to obtain the overall monosemanticity score for that setting.
blocks.zh: 对每个模型、数据源和代表物提取地点进行单调性评价。 对于每个设定,我们随机抽样抽取相应高级评价机构所学的10个候选代表单位进行评价。 每个单元,我们最多使用10个激活例。 如果有10个以上的激活实例,我们从全部激活实例中随机抽取10个;如果有不到10个,我们使用所有可用的实例。 因此,一些单位的XQS小于10。 然后,我们分别计算每个代表单位的单倍比分,并平均在同一SAE范围内抽样单位的分数,以获得该设定的整体单倍比分.

blocks.zh: 语义一致性评价

blocks.en: Single-atom semantic alignment evaluation

blocks.en: To further detail the single-atom semantic alignment evaluation described in the main text, we represent both HowNet sememes and candidate representational units in the model as entity sets and quantify their correspondence based on set overlap. blocks.en: To assess whether combinations of representational atoms can more completely recover the entity structure associated with HowNet sememes, we further perform a cross-layer compositional semantic alignment analysis. For each model, we aggregate candidate representational units that satisfy the filtering criteria described in the main text across all model layers, thereby forming a unified pool of candidate atoms.

Each cell reports the mean final F1 score obtained after greedy compositional search under the corresponding parameter setting, with colour indicating the same quantity. Within the evaluated grid, τ P = 0.5 \tau_{P}=0.5 consistently yields the highest overall alignment performance, while increasing N max N_{\max} progressively improves the final F1 score.

blocks.en: Supplementary Fig. 13: Effect of the maximum combination size on cross-layer compositional semantic alignment. Mean final F1 score across valid HowNet sememes as a function of the maximum combination size N max N_{\max} for Gemma2-2B, Gemma2-9B and Llama3.1-8B, with the candidate-filtering precision threshold fixed at τ P = 0.5 \tau_{P}=0.5 . For all three models, increasing N max N_{\max} progressively improves compositional semantic alignment, with the gains becoming substantially smaller at larger combination sizes and the performance approaching a plateau by N max = 800 N_{\max}=800 . These results support the use of N max = 800 N_{\max}=800 in the subsequent cross-layer compositional semantic alignment analyses.
